fields.name: channel
fields.description: Specify X-Splunk-Request-Channel header for the HTTP Event Collector interface.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism. Allowed value: gzip.

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target Splunk service.

fields.name: http_buffer_size
fields.description: Buffer size used to receive Splunk HTTP responses.

fields.name: http_debug_bad_request
fields.description: If the HTTP server response code is 400 (bad request) and this flag is enabled, it will print the full HTTP request and response to the stdout interface. This feature is available for debugging purposes.

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Password for user defined in http_user.

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Optional username for basic authentication on HEC.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target Splunk service.

fields.name: splunk_token
fields.description: Specify the authentication token for the HTTP Event Collector interface.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: event_field
fields.description: Set event fields for the record. This option can be set multiple times and the format is key_name record_accessor_pattern.

fields.name: event_host
fields.description: Specify the key name that contains the host value. This option allows a record accessors pattern.

fields.name: event_index
fields.description: The name of the index by which the event data is to be indexed.

fields.name: event_index_key
fields.description: Set a record key that will populate the index field. If the key is found, it will have precedence over the value set in event_index.

fields.name: event_key
fields.description: Specify the key name that will be used to send a single value as part of the record.

fields.name: event_source
fields.description: Set the source value to assign to the event data.

fields.name: event_sourcetype
fields.description: Set the sourcetype value to assign to the event data.

fields.name: event_sourcetype_key
fields.description: Set a record key that will populate sourcetype. If the key is found, it will have precedence over the value set in event_sourcetype.

fields.name: splunk_send_raw
fields.description: When enabled, the record keys and values are set in the top level of the map instead of under the event key. See Sending Raw Events to configure this option.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
